Create a production VFX texture ATLAS, not a concept picture. Exact regular 4-column by 2-row grid, eight equal tiles, no dividers, no labels, no text, no mechanical objects. Pure BLACK background in every tile for additive/luminance compositing. Each effect stays inside the central 75% of its tile with a generous clean black border, no light reaching adjacent tiles. Landscape 2:1, high resolution, clean fine detail. Tile positions left to right, top row: (0) thin vertical white/amber calibration filament with subtle hot core; (1) intricate amber architectural wire lattice, lines and vertices, no solid planes; (2) elegant concentric amber acoustic ripple arcs fading outward; (3) horizontal crimson capillary pulse with tiny white leading highlight. Bottom row: (4) fine gold constellation engraving pattern across a narrow horizontal strip; (5) restrained warm amber optical lens halo and iris caustic; (6) bright thin warm-white/ochre accretion disk as a flat top-view annulus with black center and finely streaked flow; (7) cold-white/very pale-blue distorted spatial grid narrowing into a throat, wispy contour filaments. These are actual texture elements to sample in a 3D game, not panels with titles or examples on objects. Crisp authored gradients, rich fine luminance variation, antialiased soft ends. No purple, no large fog clouds, no extra tiles.

Create a production planet ALBEDO texture atlas, no illustration lighting or spheres. Portrait 2:3, three equal-height horizontal rectangular bands stacked vertically. Each band is a full flat 2:1 equirectangular planet surface map with horizontally seamless left/right edges. No margins, dividers, text, borders, highlights, cast shadows, black background, separate planets or labels. TOP band: grey rocky cratered moon-like world with fine impact ejecta and subtle mineral variation. MIDDLE band: fictional deep cobalt-blue ocean world with pale mineral land shapes and restrained white cloud bands, original geography not Earth. BOTTOM band: ochre/copper gas giant surface with horizontal fluid bands, small vortices and cream turbulence. Uniform diffuse texture illumination so the 3D renderer can light it properly. High-resolution fine material detail, intended for close-up miniature worlds in an Atomic Heart-inspired apparatus. The image must be exactly three flat rectangular texture maps filling their bands, not three shaded globes.
